newsitem.title: UK: Wet Brent trades again, three cents firmer - trade.
newsitem.headline: Wet Brent trades again, three cents firmer - trade.

text.p: A physical Brent cargo due to load between February 18-20 traded between European majors on Tuesday at Mar Brent +30 cents a barrel, three cents higher than an earlier trade, traders said.
A Brent cargo due to load February 17-19 traded between European majors earlier on Tuesday at Mar Brent +27 cents a barrel.
The Brent that changed hands at Mar +30 was one of two that went unclaimed at Monday's five o'clock deadline.
